guidance.statement: EBITDA margin should be good and can sustainably improve going forward.
guidance.quote: I don't want to guide towards any direction, but I think it can sustainably improve going forward.

achieved.claim: GMV growth came out at around 28% year-on-year growth at INR 5,795 crores.
Net revenue is at about INR 2,873 crores, which is a 27% year-on-year.
EBITDA is at about INR 230 crores, which is 8.0% of net revenue and 63% year-on-year growth.
Beauty business EBITDA now stands at 10.1% of net revenue for the quarter.
